summary: Two 23-year-old out-of-state hikers became lost hiking back down from the Flattop Mountain summit; they contacted the park by cell phone in the afternoon; park SAR searched the Flattop Mountain and Mill Creek Basin areas and found them above the Banana Bowls around 10,600 feet at about 8 p.m., escorting them out to the Bear Lake trailhead around 9:45 p.m.; neither had snowshoes or backcountry gear.
location: Flattop Mountain summit descent, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park SAR
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Flattop Mountain)
